text:
Elena Park: Quick heads-up — search is returning the old canonical URL for /kb/runtime/caching. Found a redirect chain 301 -> 302 -> 200 that looks like it's causing the crawler to treat the page as non-canonical. Saw it in smoke tests: https://search.internal/redwood?q=runtime+caching
Samir Patel: @Elena Park can you paste the exact failing URL? I can check CDN rules.
Elena Park: Sure — root hit: https://kb.redwood.dev/runtime/caching -> redirects to https://kb.redwood.dev/docs/caching (301) -> then to https://kb.redwood.dev/docs/caching/overview (302) -> final 200. The canonical on final page still points to /runtime/caching
docs-bot: scan result: Redirect chain detected (ID R-4821). Affected path: /runtime/caching. Suggested action: update canonical or collapse redirects.
Kai Nguyen: That mismatch will confuse search and the console breadcrumbs. I'd prefer updating the canonical on the final page to /docs/caching if that's the actual canonical. Lina, you're the owner of the /docs/* tree? @Lina Morales
Lina Morales: I own docs/caching. The original /runtime/caching was an old alias. We intended the canonical to be /docs/caching/overview. Probably missed during the nav refactor. I'll open a quick PR to update frontmatter.
Samir Patel: Thanks. Can you also add a small Netlify redirect to eliminate the extra 302? Something like:
```
[[redirects]]
from = "/docs/caching"
to = "/docs/caching/overview"
status = 301
```
Elena Park: Also, staging preview for this page failed to render earlier — getting a 404 on images when previewing. Lina, when you open the PR can you include a deploy preview link so I can re-run the search smoke?
Lina Morales: Yep, I'll include preview and tag @Samir for the redirect check. ETA: PR in ~30m. :thumbsup:
Kai Nguyen: If we change canonical, we'll need to bump the sitemap and notify the search reindex job. I can queue a reindex once PR merges.
Samir Patel: I'll look at CDN rules in parallel. If we collapse redirects we should update the CDN cache keys afterwards.
Elena Park: Awesome — thanks team. I'll rerun the internal smoke after merge and report back here.
(Reaction summary: :eyes: from Kai Nguyen, :rocket: from Lina Morales)
